method: The full-resolution direct-Rumsey scan was opened in QGIS. Four engraved meridian labels and two engraved parallel labels were read directly, their rules were followed through the sheet, and all eight crossings were measured independently on full-resolution crops. Linen folds, the magnetic-variation line, shoreline strokes, the frame and neatlines were excluded before the two corner checks were withheld.
qa_review: The top labels read 60d25mW, 60d20mW, 60d15mW and 60d10mW from west to east. The left frame labels read 46d55mN and 46d50mN from north to south. The contact sheet visibly separates the graticule from a diagonal magnetic-variation line at the north-west control, Trout Brook at the south-west controls, linen folds and the map frame.
